project.domain: Python-hosted language runtime and scientific modeling environment
project.mission: Provide an experimental programming environment for scientific modeling and reproducible workflows.

explicit_non_goals: Do not claim a complete source-to-machine-code native compiler
Do not claim a full LSP implementation
Do not treat experimental features as production-ready

safety_boundaries: Keep the Python-hosted runtime and native compiler slice as distinct execution paths unless an explicit contract is implemented.
Scientific outputs must state model assumptions and reproducibility limits.
Experimental syntax and extensions must not silently change stable language semantics.

native_validation.evidence_note: Run relevant commands for the changed component; target-specific compiler claims require target evidence.
